stages.title: Communication cycle
stages.body: Sender, encoding, message, channel, receiver, decoding and feedback.

stages.title: Channel choice
stages.body: Match urgency, complexity, privacy, reach and record needs.

stages.title: Verbal and non-verbal
stages.body: Align words, tone, posture and context.

stages.title: Feedback
stages.body: Make it timely, specific, behavioural and two-way.

stages.title: Barriers
stages.body: Diagnose semantic, physical, psychological, cultural and organisational blocks.

stages.title: Interpersonal styles
stages.body: Prefer assertive respect over passivity or aggression.

stages.title: Conflict
stages.body: Separate positions from interests and facts from assumptions.

stages.title: Negotiation
stages.body: Prepare interests, options, objective criteria and a lawful BATNA.

stages.title: Public dealing
stages.body: Use accessible language, procedural fairness and documented follow-up.

stages.title: Questionnaires
stages.body: Avoid leading, double-barrelled and ambiguous questions.

stages.title: Scenario decision
stages.body: Choose the feasible response that reduces harm and preserves trust.
